PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Lists the blocks that make sound and mutes them, per block, per type on a grid, or per type everywhere.
PluginData.Description:
Lists the blocks that make sound and lets you mute them: one block, every block of a type on one grid, or a whole block type everywhere. Weapons are listed by their shot sound, and modded blocks work too.
Muting only changes what your own PC plays. Nothing is sent to the server, nothing is stored on the grid, and other players still hear everything.
Quick start: 1. Type /hush in chat. 2. Pick one of your grids, select a block and press Mute / Unmute, or use Mute Type on Grid. 3. Types everywhere mutes a block type on every grid, in every world.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Hush Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
